decisions.decision: Fix the problem in the deck's source files, not only in the published copy, so the next rebuild does not bring the 404 back. In /Users/adithyamurali/YOGI/v1-build/deck-preview/_rebuild/slides/*.html, change every url('tantra-logo.png') to url('uploads/tantra-logo.png'). Then run `node build.js`, copy deck.html to index.html in Usetantra/tantra-webinar-deck, and push. Also commit the slide change to the private repo Usetantra/webinar-deck. After the push, curl every logo URL the deck requests and confirm each returns 200. Load the live URL in a real browser, take a screenshot of the cover slide (goTo(0)) and check every slide for broken images. Next, remove the 404 note from review_hub.py:257, regenerate workshop-plan/index.html, and mark H038 fixed in AUDIT.md with the deck commit SHA. Move the task to review for Bhaskar with the screenshot.
decisions.why: The spec is fully verified (pass 2, 2026-10-08) and the fix is mechanical. The webinar-deck-hosting memory says to edit _rebuild/slides and never deck.html, because deck.html is generated. Both repos belong to Tantra. Under orchestrator-autonomy (2026-10-09), pushing to our own repos needs no ask.
